title: (RHBA-2014:0583) struts bug fix update
portal_summary:
Updated struts packages that fix one bug are now available for Red Hat Satellite
5.6.
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/site/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a systems management tool for Linux-based
infrastructures. It allows for provisioning, monitoring, and remote
management of multiple Linux deployments with a single, centralized tool.

Apache Struts is a framework for building web applications with Java.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Due to a dependency error, the Apache Struts packages deployed with the
RHSA-2014:0500 advisory did not install cleanly on Red Hat Satellite 5.6 systems
that were upgraded from previous versions. Affected customers can manually
uninstall the "struts-tiles" RPM package to resolve this problem without any
negative side effect. Or, they can apply this update that allows for installing
the struts packages cleanly without any additional effort. (BZ#1098409)

All Satellite users are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
this bug. For this update to take effect, the tomcat6 service must be restarted
("service tomcat6 restart").
